items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998

ctx.x: One of them finally went to Europe, right?
Eddie went to Europe to conduct the Baden Baden, West German Jazz Band. He took a couple of guys from the band with him, including the harpist Blanche Birdsong went and © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Sperry Kassman went in percussion and Dave Hildinger went on percussion and piano. And the bass player went.
